title: Walls & Devine: Volume 1 Release Roadmap
summary: File-backed checklist and release guidance for Volume 1. This is the source of truth for the rollout sequence until Firebase-backed content management is added.
guidance: Keep June 4, 2026 as the album release date.
Release Resolve before the album only if it can be uploaded immediately and pitched in Spotify for Artists with at least 7 days lead time.
When Resolve appears on the album, preserve the same ISRC, identical audio file, and identical metadata where possible.
Treat the instrumental edition as a separate release so it becomes a second campaign wave instead of a rushed add-on.
recommendedSetup: Volume 1: Instrumentals — the world behind the songs
avoid: Do not compress Resolve, the album, and the instrumental edition into one short attention window.
Do not reuse the Vol. 1 cover for the Resolve single artwork.
Do not re-pitch Resolve as the album focus track if it already served as the single pitch.

calendar.purpose: Get it delivered and pitchable ASAP

calendar.action: Pitch Resolve in Spotify for Artists
calendar.purpose: Needs at least 7 days before May 24
Keep album alive after release day
Extend the world behind the songs

checklist.title: Lock Resolve single artwork
checklist.notes: Use the Resolve art, not the Vol. 1 cover. Treat the single as its own chapter.

checklist.title: Upload Resolve as a single in DistroKid
checklist.notes: Audio, artwork, metadata, and credits should all be final before upload.

checklist.title: Save Resolve ISRC for album carryover
checklist.notes: Reuse the same ISRC, audio file, title, and artist name when Resolve appears on the album.

checklist.title: Pitch Resolve in Spotify for Artists
checklist.notes: Pitch as soon as the unreleased single appears in Spotify for Artists.

checklist.title: Prepare 9-grid post sequence
checklist.notes: Use the red-and-white visual system to build from Resolve into the full album world.

checklist.title: Upload Volume 1 album in DistroKid
checklist.notes: Track list: Joint Queen, Stash Daddy, Space Cruiser, Home, Decay, Resolve, Poetry, Gratitude.

checklist.title: Choose album focus track for Spotify pitch
checklist.notes: Recommended focus track: Poetry. Alternatives: Gratitude or Joint Queen.

checklist.title: Run post-release focus window for album
checklist.notes: Keep the album alive after release day instead of moving immediately into the next upload.

checklist.title: Assign new ISRCs to instrumental recordings
checklist.notes: Instrumentals are separate recordings and should not reuse the vocal ISRCs.

checklist.title: Upload Volume 1: Instrumentals
checklist.notes: Mark tracks as instrumental in DistroKid and use clean version info formatting.
